description:
intent=i044 snapshot=s11 branch=fixed-epidx-rest status=complete
finding location=drivers/isdn/gigaset/usb-gigaset.c:706-741 confidence=high conclusion=gigaset_probe indexes endpoint[0]/endpoint[1] of an unvalidated descriptor array (zero bNumEndpoints checks in the file) to size kmalloc buffers and program bulk/interrupt URBs; a 0/1-endpoint M105-spoofing gadget crashes probe or feeds OOB-read values into URB setup at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/usb/atm/ueagle-atm.c:2205-2213 confidence=high conclusion=uea_boot reads actconfig->interface[0]->altsetting[0].endpoint[0].desc.bInterval with no bNumEndpoints validation and submits the interrupt URB with it; a zero-endpoint interface-0 Eagle-spoofing gadget OOB-reads descriptor memory at modem bind (plug-in).
finding location=drivers/watchdog/pcwd_usb.c:632-648 confidence=high conclusion=usb_pcwd_probe indexes endpoint[0].desc with no bNumEndpoints check (only a HID-class check precedes) and feeds the read into usb_endpoint_is_int_in, pipe setup and URB buffer sizing; a zero-endpoint gadget OOB-reads descriptor memory at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/input/joystick/iforce/iforce-usb.c:142-171 confidence=high conclusion=iforce_usb_probe reads cur_altsetting->endpoint[0] and endpoint[1] with zero bNumEndpoints validation and uses their bEndpointAddress/bInterval to program and submit two interrupt URBs; a 0/1-endpoint joystick-spoofing gadget OOB-reads or crashes at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/input/tablet/hanwang.c:408-413 confidence=high conclusion=hanwang_probe reads cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc with no bNumEndpoints check anywhere in the file and uses bEndpointAddress/bInterval to program the interrupt pipe and URB; a zero-endpoint Hanwang-spoofing gadget OOB-reads descriptor memory at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/input/tablet/kbtab.c:163-168 confidence=high conclusion=kbtab_probe reads cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc with no bNumEndpoints check in the file and uses bEndpointAddress/bInterval to program the interrupt URB pipe and interval; a zero-endpoint JamTablet-spoofing gadget OOB-reads at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/input/misc/cm109.c:703-706 confidence=high conclusion=cm109_usb_probe indexes endpoint[0].desc with no bNumEndpoints check and immediately dereferences it in usb_endpoint_is_int_in at plug-in; a zero-endpoint phone-chip-spoofing gadget OOB-reads descriptor memory to pass/fail the check and feed URB setup.
finding location=drivers/input/misc/yealink.c:876-880 confidence=high conclusion=yealink usb_probe indexes endpoint[0].desc with no bNumEndpoints check and dereferences it via usb_endpoint_is_int_in at plug-in; a zero-endpoint Yealink-spoofing gadget OOB-reads descriptor memory feeding interrupt URB setup.
finding location=drivers/usb/misc/idmouse.c:358-367 confidence=high conclusion=idmouse_probe indexes altsetting[0].endpoint[0].desc with only a class check (no bNumEndpoints in the file) and dereferences it via usb_endpoint_is_bulk_in, using maxp/address for buffer size and the bulk pipe; a zero-endpoint gadget OOB-reads at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/mmc/host/ushc.c:475-478 confidence=high conclusion=ushc_probe reads cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc.bEndpointAddress/bInterval with no bNumEndpoints check anywhere in the file and programs the SDIO interrupt URB pipe/interval; a zero-endpoint gadget OOB-reads at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/input/touchscreen/sur40.c:526-534 confidence=high conclusion=sur40_probe reads altsetting[0].endpoint[4].desc with no bNumEndpoints check (needs >=5 endpoints) and uses its address as the polled bulk-in touch pipe; a Samsung-spoofing gadget with fewer endpoints OOB-reads descriptor memory at plug-in.
finding location=drivers/uwb/hwa-rc.c:697-711 confidence=medium conclusion=hwarc_neep_init reads cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc.bEndpointAddress/bInterval with no bNumEndpoints check in the file and submits a PAGE_SIZE interrupt URB with them; a zero-endpoint HWA-RC-class gadget OOB-reads descriptor memory at bind.
finding location=drivers/uwb/i1480/dfu/usb.c:243-248 confidence=medium conclusion=i1480_usb_wait_init_done/i1480_usb_cmd read cur_altsetting->endpoint[0].desc.bEndpointAddress/bInterval with no bNumEndpoints check and program submitted interrupt URBs; a zero-endpoint i1480-spoofing gadget OOB-reads at bind/first command.
unresolved location=drivers/usb/misc/lvstest.c:369 conclusion=Follow up: read lvstest_probe fully to confirm the gadget-only ID match makes the unguarded endpoint[0] read unreachable for arbitrary attacker hardware, or whether any off-the-shelf ID match can reach it.
coverage_gap=sound/usb/stream.c, quirks.c, clock.c, mixer.c, pcm.c and endpoint.c get_endpoint(alts, 0) sites were triaged by the s10 audit of the same sound/usb code plus spot checks (pcm.c:423 guard re-verified), not re-read line-by-line in s11; a dedicated sound/usb re-audit was not performed.
coverage_gap=drivers/usb/core/{config,devio,driver,hcd,hub,message}.c and drivers/usb/host/{xhci,ehci-sched,fotg210}.c accesses are the descriptor parser itself or loop-bounded (config.c:244 loops i < nendpoints; hub.c:1737 is the hub's own interrupt ep) and were only spot-checked, not exhaustively re-audited.
coverage_gap=Whether the OOB-read values (bEndpointAddress, bInterval, wMaxPacketSize) in the reported findings can be escalated beyond probe-time crash/DoS (e.g. mis-sized buffers later overflowed) was not traced beyond the immediate pipe-programming and buffer-sizing uses named in the reasons.
